    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    BigBlockingQueue<T>
    A thread-safe BigQueue where the BigBlockingQueue.pop() operation blocks until an element is available.
    Generate
    A tool that generates a story graph from a Tandem Tales logical story world.
    GraphExpander
    A graph expander manages the generation of a story graph from a Tandem Tales logical story world, serving as a central point for many node expanding threads to report their work and ensuring that nodes are generated in a deterministic order.
    UtilityMap
    A simple BiFunction that defines what utility value a Tandem Tales character has in a given state and which can be easily serialized to and deserialized from a JSON file.
    UtilityMap.Branch
    A condition and expression pair which are used in a utility function to define conditions under which a character has a certain utility.
    UtilityMap.Utility
    A simple Function that defines what utility its Tandem Tales character has in a given state.
